biggest_catch: The program is dead: Coinbase's official help page states 'Coinbase Learning rewards are no longer available as of May 27, 2025' — there is nothing to earn.
catches: Coinbase officially ended Learning rewards on May 27, 2025; the Earn program no longer exists.
No learning modules or quizzes are currently available to complete for rewards.
The catalog's '$3-$10 per module' describes the defunct pre-2025 program, not anything a user can do now.

notes: Death evidence: official Coinbase Help 'Learning rewards' page (help.coinbase.com, both indexed versions crawled 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-23) states flatly: 'Coinbase Learning rewards are no longer available as of May 27, 2025. To earn more crypto, try staking your assets.' Third-party sources (e.g. blockchainmagazine.net) corroborate the shutdown. The only in-app 'earn' option Coinbase points to is staking, which requires holding your own crypto — a different mechanism, not a learn-and-earn payout. No commits, no DB writes.
